clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.content:
"The Service" refers to the RevisionBase repository, inclusive of static files, dynamic Interactive Resources, and visual simulations.

"DCAM" (Dynamic Cognitive Assessment Module) refers to the logic-based tools provided for revision and stress testing.

clauses.title: Data Architecture
clauses.content: We use a hybrid data model involving plain-text webhooks and cryptographic hashing. By using the Service, you explicitly consent to the email transmission and UCI generation.

clauses.title: Institutional Use
clauses.content: THE PROVIDER EXPLICITLY DISCLAIMS ANY LIABILITY FOR UNAUTHORIZED USE WITHIN SCHOOLS or WORKPLACES. Accessing Interactive Resources during scheduled lessons is strictly prohibited.

clauses.title: Educational Intent
clauses.content: Interactive Resources are supplemental tools aimed at cognitive reflex and logic training. Any recreational enjoyment is purely incidental.

clauses.title: Session Context
clauses.content: When you visit any page, a Page ID Code and your UCI are sent to the server to serve relevant announcements.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.content: You are granted a limited, personal licence to use the Service. Mirroring or scraping is prohibited.

clauses.title: Resource Logging
clauses.content: Browsers transmit IP addresses, email hashes, and UCIs to verify 'state' and prevent link sharing via webhooks.

clauses.title: Continuity
clauses.content: We reserve the right to suspend the Service or change domains at any time without notice.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.content: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED 'AS IS'. THE PROVIDER DISCLAIMS ALL LIABILITY FOR DATA LOSS, ACADEMIC FAILURE, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES.

clauses.title: Health & Safety
clauses.content: Interactive resources may contain flashing images. Users with photosensitivity should use at their own risk.

clauses.title: Third-Party Platforms
clauses.content: Data collection is frequently conducted via Google Forms. You are subject to Google's Terms of Service.

clauses.title: Disciplinary Consequences
clauses.content: The Provider will not provide logs or testimony to defend your usage if you are subject to school disciplinary action.
